relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: suzetrigine, a newly U.S. Food and Drug Administration-approved selective NaV1.8 sodium channel inhibitor

key_findings: Suzetrigine is a peripherally acting NaV1.8 inhibitor noninferior to hydrocodone/acetaminophen in acute postsurgical pain.
Use in palliative and hospice care is limited by lack of evidence, a 14-day safety restriction and high cost.
